rights: All observations are original synthetic values; no vessel, carrier, operator, terminal or source-provider records are included.

censoring_assumption: Aalen-Johansen requires non-informative censoring conditional on cohort/strata. Reporting-lag censoring is separately identified but not modeled; real-data probabilities require reporting-delay diagnostics and sensitivity analysis.
